name: garmin-cn-sync-cloud
description: Setup guidance and safe analysis workflows for your self-hosted Garmin China MCP server.

interface.shortDescription: Set up your Garmin China MCP
interface.longDescription: Guides each user to deploy a private Cloudflare Worker, connect their own Garmin China Personal API Key with OAuth, and interpret read-only health and activity data. The marketplace package does not host or preconfigure a shared data endpoint; each user adds their own Worker URL.
capabilities: Guide deployment of a personal Garmin China MCP endpoint
Interpret read-only Garmin sleep, recovery, and activity data
defaultPrompt: Help me set up my own Garmin China Sync Cloud Worker.
Summarize my Garmin sleep and HRV for the last 7 days.
Compare my last two Garmin runs by pace and heart rate.
